behaviors.description: Parse app and runtime literal refs.
behaviors.preconditions: Literal full refs for x86_64 and aarch64.
behaviors.expected: Kind, name, arch, branch and allocating format match the literals; commit is NULL.

behaviors.preconditions: Empty, missing-component, invalid-kind, empty-name and extra-component inputs.
behaviors.expected: Each returns NULL and a GError.

behaviors.description: Check cached formatting and independently owned strings.
behaviors.preconditions: Live parsed app and runtime refs.
behaviors.expected: Cached pointer is stable and literal-correct; freeing one allocated string preserves the ref and cache; the other string survives ref destruction.

behaviors.description: Read explicit ref commit and collection ID from a public-property fixture.
behaviors.preconditions: Public construct-only properties supply literal values; no repository metadata is read.
behaviors.expected: Getters return the supplied 64-character commit and collection ID. This checks the Ref object contract only, not collection-ID propagation from a repository or bundle.
references: common/flatpak-ref.c: public commit and collection-id properties; flatpak_ref_get_collection_id

mappings.rationale: Both literal ref kinds have all identity components, formatting and absent commit asserted.
All malformed inputs require NULL and a non-NULL error, including missing component and invalid kind.
Literal equality, borrowed pointer stability, independent frees, live-ref inspection and post-destruction owned-string inspection are asserted.

The requirement's explicit-ID ref fixture is supplied through the public collection-id property and verified by the getter. Credit covers object-level exposure only; this does not verify repository or bundle metadata propagation.
